attempted_claim: In the notation of Davison–Mandel, let D_in = {(v_i^⊥, E(-p_i(t) z^{v_i})) : v_i ∈ L_0^+, i = 1,…,s} be a finite quantum scattering diagram over 𝔤_{L_0^+,ω}, with every p_i(t) ∈ ℤ_{≥0}[t^{±1}] of Lefschetz type. Must Scat(D_in) have a consistent representative whose every wall function p_d(t) is of Lefschetz type, including for cyclic exchange data?
decisive_failure: No general proof of the open Lefschetz-preservation conjecture was found; rank-2 computations cannot test genuinely cyclic exchange data by dimension reasons; the rank-3 heuristic used an invalid wall ordering (positivity-violating defects) and was discarded; computed Lefschetz decompositions are verification evidence only, not theorems.
